# The World of AI
> The atlas of artificial intelligence: US state AI legislation, major AI
> lawsuits, the language of AI, and the tools people actually use, rebuilt
> daily from primary sources (LegiScan, CourtListener/RECAP, the Federal
> Register). An independent publication of SRJ Consulting & Services LLC,
> Frisco, Texas.

Every reference page carries a "Last verified" date and a ready-made citation.
Citing these pages with attribution is welcome and encouraged.

## Sections
- [AI Laws by State](https://theworldofai.org/ai-laws/): every tracked AI bill
  in all 50 US states, DC, Puerto Rico, and Congress, one page per jurisdiction.
- [AI Glossary](https://theworldofai.org/ai-glossary/): 500+ AI terms defined
  in plain English with origin and example.
- [AI Lawsuit Tracker](https://theworldofai.org/ai-lawsuits/): living case
  pages with daily docket checks and full timelines.
- [AI Tools Directory](https://theworldofai.org/ai-tools/): 320 tools across 23
  categories, with in-depth profiles covering pricing, strengths, weaknesses,
  and governance notes for the tools we have researched directly.
- [AI Calculators](https://theworldofai.org/calculators/): token cost and GPU
  VRAM estimators.

## Machine-readable data
- https://theworldofai.org/api/laws.json (per-state counts and index)
- https://theworldofai.org/api/glossary.json (all terms)
- https://theworldofai.org/api/lawsuits.json (all tracked cases)
- https://theworldofai.org/api/tools.json (tool catalog, categories, profiles)

## About this publication
- https://theworldofai.org/about/ (who publishes this and how pages are made)
- https://theworldofai.org/contact/ (corrections, press, data questions)
- https://theworldofai.org/disclosure/ (advertising and affiliate policy)

## Update cadence
All data refreshes once daily via an automated pipeline; the "generated" field
in each API file is the verification date.

## Citation format
"{Page title}." The World of AI, {URL}. Verified {date}.
